title: The Steeled Brow Discipline
summary: The school discipline of steeling the will behind the brow until no pressure bends it and ending in the school's immovable stand.

title: Azure Diadem Treatise of Command
summary: The school treatise on a will worn like a diadem that commands the field and closes in the school's crowning blow.

title: Canon of the Unbroken Pledge
summary: The school canon of a pledge that no blow can break and that finally returns its weight to those who share it.

title: The Sky-Anchored Will Crown
summary: The school's high course in a will anchored to the sky itself that falls from the formed core as an unanswerable verdict.

title: The Gale Pact Discipline
summary: The school discipline of a pact struck with the wind that is kept through every gust and ends in the school's pact of storms.

title: Reckoning of the Resolute Wind
summary: The school reckoning of a wind that will not be turned and flings back every force it meets.

title: The Gale-Sworn Resolve Canon
summary: The school canon of a resolve sworn to the gale that never tires and returns the force of any strike as eternal weight.

title: The Oath Beneath the Storm
summary: The school's deepest oath set beneath the storm itself and loosed from the formed core as a bound tempest.
